purpose: Correct source-overreach and distinguish the customer's ultimate progress from purchase conditions while preserving original stable IDs.

code_proposals.original_issue: States that old mattress caused impaired functioning
code_proposals.proposed_definition: Participant associates recurring waking discomfort and perceived sinkage with the existing mattress, while other causes remain possible.
Buyer perceives risk of being unable to recover from another disappointing purchase.
Business, childcare and moving demands repeatedly displace mattress replacement priority.
Buyer reports aversion to conventional mattress sales settings, without denying having visited them.
Older mattress was still kept or used after purchase; a post-adoption outcome unknown remains.
Wake restored enough to function well in work and family roles.
Find a purchase path whose failure can credibly be reversed or recovered.
Act when a feasible joint purchasing occasion becomes available.
Evaluate a materially different mattress in a way the household can tolerate.

link_proposals.reason: Reported waking discomfort and desired functioning are closely connected, without confirming mattress causation.
The purchase-recovery concern is reported; free pickup did not enter the original choice because it was learned about later.
Competing obligations and a joint Costco purchase occurred, but there is no defensible link establishing that obligations caused this purchase moment.
Retail aversion and sample use coexist but do not establish their independent causal roles.

distinct_roles.actual_result: UNKNOWN: historic sleep improvement not established
